shadcn_overrides.tabs: Override h-9 to h-auto. Use underline style instead of pill style for a more Swiss, editorial look.
shadcn_overrides.dialog: Remove rounded-lg, use rounded-sm. No soft backdrop blur, use a solid bg-black/40 overlay.
shadcn_overrides.avatar: Use square avatars with rounded-sm corners instead of full circles to match the Swiss Grid aesthetic.

login_background.description: Abstract wavy orange texture for auth page side panel

avatars.description: Professional male avatar for sales agent

instructions_to_main_agent: Build standard React (.js/.jsx) with Tailwind. Do not use TypeScript.
Strictly follow the High-Contrast Swiss aesthetic. Do not use generic blue defaults. Primary action color must be #FF4500 (Electric Orange).
Use pure HTML/Tailwind to build the macro grid layouts. Only use Shadcn for interactive logic (Dialogs, Dropdowns, Datepickers).
All interactive elements MUST include a data-testid attribute (e.g., data-testid='login-button').
Use 'lucide-react' for all icons. Ensure they are sized appropriately.
The left-side main app navigation should be highly contrasting: Dark background (#0A0A0A) with white text/icons.

For the WhatsApp-style inbox, implement a 3-column layout: Left (Contacts/Chats), Middle (Chat Thread), Right (Lead Info & AI Summary). The middle chat thread must use distinct visual bubbles for Bot vs Human.
AI functionality (Summaries and Suggested Replies) should be visually distinct. Use the ai_surface color (#FFF7ED) and an icon to indicate machine-generated assistance.
Kanban board should use the bento-grid approach. Columns should have a light zinc background, cards should be solid white with a 1px border.
Ensure 'Bot to Human' handoff toggle is prominent in the conversation header.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text over Electric Orange buttons is white. Body text on white backgrounds should be text-[#52525B] or darker.
accessibility.focus: All focusable elements must have focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#FF4500] focus:outline-none focus:ring-offset-1.
